messages:
Sam Patel: Heads up - OrionBank's security team wants an EU-only POC (strict). Requirements: tenant pinned to eu-west-1, BYO KMS, VPC peering, and a signed sub-processor attestation. Can we triage?
Maria Gomez: Noted. Do they require Dedicated or is hosted with hard pin acceptable? They mentioned 'no cross-border data, no exceptions' in the questionnaire.
Ben Wright: Quick infra note: we can do Dedicated pinned (eu-west-1) or hosted with tenant_pin + no-failover flag. Dedicated gives deterministic locality; hosted requires routing policy lock and extra attestation.
Noor Ahmed: Legal wants exact list of subprocessors that will process data during the POC window and cert evidence (SOC2/ISO links). Also need sight of the key handling flow for BYO KMS.
Sam Patel: They also asked: will any logs (debug, metrics) ever leave EU? They need confirmation in writing.
Ben Wright: Default: metrics are aggregated in-region, but some central telemetry metadata (non-PII) flows to control plane in eu control plane — we can provide a config toggle to suppress cross-region telemetry for the POC.
Maria Gomez: Great. Pricing ask: Orion wants a 1-week fast POC. What's the delta between hosted pin vs dedicated reserved for that week? Also any setup fees for peering/cert exchange?
Ben Wright: Ballpark: Dedicated reserved (1 week demo) ~= 5,000 for reserving minimal GPU slab + network; hosted pinned trial ~= 2,500 + KMS ops & egress ~600. Will refine with exact SKU numbers.
Noor Ahmed: Contractually: we'll need a short POC addendum that binds us to no cross-border routing, lists subprocessors, and confirms BYO KMS flow (we do envelope encryption, never persist plaintext keys). I'll draft language.
ops-bot: Ticket created: RDW-1256 - "OrionBank EU-only POC: VPC peering, BYO KMS, subproc attestation" assigned to @ben.w
Sam Patel: Can infra produce a runbook: VPC peering steps, cert exchange, how to provide KMS key ARN and test encryption, plus what logs we'll provide to the customer?
Ben Wright: Yes. Runbook steps I'll include: 1) CIDR handshake + peering; 2) cert chain exchange (PEM bundles); 3) test endpoints and curl examples; 4) KMS ARN verification + sample encrypt/decrypt flow; 5) smoke tests for locality (traceroute + request ID verification).
Maria Gomez: Please include a simple config snippet for the routing policy (we'll paste to the customer):

Ben Wright: code: 
```
routing_policy: tenant_pin
allowed_regions: ["eu-west-1"]
failover: "none"
telemetry: "eu-only"
```

Noor Ahmed: Addendum requirement: notification window if any routing changes are proposed, plus right to pause the POC if anything routes outside of EU.
Sam Patel: Ops question: can we provide a signed attestation listing active subprocessors for the POC timeframe? Not just a link.
Ben Wright: We can produce a signed export (PDF) of the attested subproc list scoped to services used in the POC. It will reference vendor names and certification links; ops will attach last-reviewed dates.
ops-bot: RDW-1256 status updated -> "assigned"
legal-bot: FYI - storing runbook or cert bundles in customer folder requires limited access. Recommend share-only links and include hashed checksums for certs.
Maria Gomez: Timeline: Orion wants to kick off next Monday and demo Friday. Doable?
Ben Wright: Ops load: tight but doable if we have certs and peering details by Tue AM. KMS key policy must allow Redwood principal to encrypt/decrypt (or we run verification steps).
Noor Ahmed: I'll prepare the POC addendum and DPA checklist by EOD tomorrow.
Sam Patel: Action owners: Ben = runbook + subproc export; Maria = pricing final; Noor = addendum + DPA; Sam = coordinate AE/customer calendar. Aim for first deliverables by Tue 09:00 UTC.
Everyone: +1
Ben Wright: I'll post a minimal test matrix in the runbook: 1) Verify request source/egress in eu-west-1; 2) Verify KMS envelope encryption (sample payload roundtrip); 3) Latency check under 250ms p95 for 256-token model; 4) Audit log export for POC window.
Maria Gomez: I'll prepare a short pricing note and include a one-slide comparison for AE.
ops-bot: RDW-1256 comment: cert bundle requested. Attach when ready.
Sam Patel: Please keep all artifacts in the deal folder /deals/OrionBank/poc/ so Legal can review.
Ben Wright: Will upload runbook + test scripts to that folder and ping when ready.
Noor Ahmed: Draft addendum will reference: no cross-border routing, subproc list, BYO KMS envelope flow, and incident notification SLA for the POC.
Maria Gomez: ETA pricing numbers 8 hours.
Ben Wright: ETA runbook + subproc export 18 hours.
ops-bot: RDW-1256 status updated -> "in progress"
Sam Patel: Thanks team. We'll sync if any blockers. :thumbsup:
